title: The Internet Slop Warehouse
author: Nyto_merrie
selftext:
I've been working on a fun little project for all my slop games I've been building, maybe someone here will find it useful. 

[https://internet-slop-warehouse.quickbeam.workers.dev/](https://internet-slop-warehouse.quickbeam.workers.dev/)

It's a free, totally unsafe, unmoderated,  commons for unadulterated AI slop, and it's open for publishers to play around with.  It's generally built for threejs slop. Everything is either CC0 else generated by an agent, though of course there's no enforcement here yet. All data is in IPFS and anchored onchain in a contract on Base Sepolia - this is an unstable testnet build but I couldn't not share early.  
  
You can use the MCP to let your agent find assets, scenes, logic, etc without having to search the web, as well as remix games, logic, and publish/consume agent skills meant to help build games. In some ways it's a cross-agent workspace for building and sharing assets and games. Hopefully we can all help each other, and eventually we build a collective world that \*isn't\* slop.
